title: Normalized left extension from a resolving class
statement:
For an additive ordinary adjunction E⊣R of abelian categories with unbounded derived categories, with R exact, suppose a class p of cochain complexes resolves every complex and E carries quasi-isomorphisms between p-objects to quasi-isomorphisms. There is a normalized derived left extension retaining exactly E and its ordinary adjunction: an everywhere defined pointwise universal left derived functor, its comparison invertible on p, exact triangulated and shift structure, a derived adjunction to D(R), and the prescribed cochain transpose formula.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe a av b bv dA dB
variable {A : Type a} [Category.{av} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{dA} A]
  {D : Type b} [Category.{bv} D] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{dB} D]
theorem nonempty_normalizedLeftExtension
    (R : D ⥤ A) [R.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
    (E : A ⥤ D) [E.Additive] (adj : E ⊣ R)
    (p : CochainComplex A ℤ → Prop)
    (res : ∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ∃ (L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (f : L ⟶ K), p L ∧ QuasiIso f)
    (inv : ∀ {K L : CochainComplex A ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L),
      p K → p L → QuasiIso f →
        QuasiIso ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f)) :
    Nonempty (SystemLeftExtensionDerivation R E adj p)
```

proof.text: Apply the existing left-derived-from-resolving-class theorem to E. Pass its comparison through the homotopy quotient. The existing normalized derived adjunction theorem for an exact right functor supplies the derived Hom bijection. Transfer the formula back to cochains. Uniqueness of the universal left derived comparison identifies the pointwise and triangulated constructions; package the derived data while retaining the ordinary functor and adjunction definitionally.
